description: This file defines the NumberHelperService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for number formatting with options for decimal places and thousand separators.

classes.name: NumberHelperService
classes.description: A service class providing utility methods for formatting numbers, including standard and grouped thousands formatting.

methods.name: numberFormat
methods.description: Formats a floating point number with specified decimal places without grouping.

methods.name: numberFormatWithGroupedThousands
methods.description: Formats a floating point number with specified decimal places and a custom thousands separator.
